                                                                                 Mindy Liebman
                                                                          3 years ago

                                                                       This glaze is just so beautiful. I did run into a problem that I
                                                                        don't see discussed and thought I would ask. Has anyone
                                                                          else experienced "blushing" with this glaze? I had a very light
                                                             cone 6 glaze load and there was plenty of room between the
                                                                     pieces so I only had a thin film of glaze deposit on the shelf
                                                                around the pot itself. This layer extended about two inches
                                                                around the pot.
                                                                       This didn't happen with my test tiles so I was really surprised.
                                                           Any suggestions? I would really like to use this glaze again,
                                                                   but I certainly don't want to scrape the shelves again.



                                                                                                            Viola leder
                                                                                 3 years ago

Mindy Liebman I didn’t had such a dramatic situation
                                                                                                 like the one you described but it runs that’s sure. I
                                                                        threw away many cookies because of this. I don’t
                                                                                        particularly like this glaze because it never came out
                                                                                              right, or was running and get stuff stuck or it was
                                                                 opaque and under fired.
                                                                                                                                           I found a sort of sweet spot with the Camille Hoffman
                                                                   program it’s a cone 5 with slow cool that kinda gives
                                                                         5.5^ result.
                                                                                                                                           I always taper the glaze at the bottom and save the
                                                                    bottom 1cm of my item unglazed. That’s how I did
                                                                 ended up finishing my batch, I’m not sure if I will be
                                                                    making another batch tho. I use holly green from
                                                                     spectrum and even tho is not as glittery and rich it
                                                                              gives me a very similar result without all the issues I
                                                                          get with this .
